claims.evidence: Witness only describes visible features (hybrid/fitness style, front suspension, disc brakes); no brand/model or condition proof.
No clear view/readout of drivetrain components (cassette/freewheel range, shifters/derailleurs) in the report.
Both bikes are described as having front suspension forks.

risks.risk: Drivetrain may not be 18-speed as claimed (or may have worn/incorrect gears), affecting usability and value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo/video of the rear cassette/freewheel (showing number of sprockets) and the shifter/derailleur area, plus a short clip showing gear changes across all gears.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used hybrid bicycle with unknown gear count and possible drivetrain wear until gear range and shifting are confirmed.

risks.risk: Brake performance may be poor (pads worn, rotor warped, caliper issues) even if disc rotors are visible.
risks.proof: Close-up of front brake pads and rotor condition, and a clip of braking from a short roll (showing strong bite and no grinding).
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes needing inspection/service (pads/rotor) until pad thickness and rotor/brake feel are verified.

risks.risk: Tires may be worn, cracked, or may not hold air, which is common and costly to fix.
risks.proof: Close-up of tire tread and sidewalls plus a clip showing the tire inflated/holding air (or a quick pump/pressure check).
risks.if_unproven: Price with tires assumed to be at least serviceable/possibly worn, not new, until tread and sidewall condition are confirmed.

risks.risk: Suspension fork may leak or be weak (rebound/compression issues) despite appearing intact from one angle.
risks.proof: Photo/video of fork stanchions for oil leaks and a bounce/rebound test clip (showing smooth return without sticking).
risks.if_unproven: Price as suspension needing potential service until leak-free condition and basic function are confirmed.

risks.risk: Frame size may not fit the buyer; wrong size reduces resale value and buyer satisfaction.
risks.proof: Photo of the frame size/seat tube marking (if any) and a measurement of seat tube length; also a side view showing rider fit points.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case fit risk (assume size may not suit) until frame size is confirmed.

risks.risk: Hidden damage (cracks, bent fork, wheel alignment, bearing play) may exist but is not visible from the provided angle.
risks.proof: Straight-on front wheel photo (rim dents), side view of fork/frame for cracks, and a clip of wheel spin showing wobble/bearing noise.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing inspection for alignment/bearings until wheel and frame integrity are confirmed.

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing (lights, kickstand, lock, pump), reducing value versus a complete setup.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out, and a checklist of what comes with the bikes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as bike-only (no accessories) until inclusions are confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the rear cassette/freewheel showing the number of sprockets (to confirm 18-speed).
Close-up of shifters and front/rear derailleurs, plus a short clip demonstrating shifting through all gears.
Close-up photos of brake pads and rotor wear, and a clip showing braking performance from a short roll.
Close-up photos of tire tread and sidewalls, plus confirmation that tires hold air (or pressure check).
Photos of the fork stanchions for oil leaks and a bounce/rebound test clip.
Frame size confirmation: seat tube length measurement and any size marking.
Wheel and frame integrity: front wheel straight-on (no dents), wheel spin/wobble clip, and inspection photos for cracks/bends.
List and photos of included accessories (lights, kickstand, lock, pump, helmet if any).
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a hybrid/fitness bicycle with front suspension and disc brakes, but key value drivers (gear count/condition, brake and tire condition, suspension health, frame size, and hidden damage) are not verifiable from the provided view. Missing these prevents a confident worst-case price.
